answer: Both teacher decisions say to match KICD. KICD Sub-Strand 3.1 has 12 lessons and covers only insect mouthparts and bird beaks, so the unit cannot be matched by wording edits. Recommended: keep Lessons 1-5 as the KICD core and write two new KICD-aligned lessons (for example, a field or specimen observation of insect mouthparts, and a bird-beak design and testing lesson). Relabel Lessons 6-10 as clearly marked extension lessons (teeth, digestive system, enzymes, absorption, synthesis). A teacher or curriculum writer must write the new lessons, so no find-and-replace edits are given.
alternative: Trim the unit to the KICD content by removing Lessons 6-9 and expanding Lessons 2-5 into 12 lessons, and rewrite the Final Explanation to cover only mouthparts and beaks.
knock_on: Lesson 1 and Lesson 10 (lesson counts, storyline references and the bridge to digestion); Lessons 6-9 (relabelled as extension); the Final Explanation, whose Parts 3-4 on digestion and absorption would become extension or optional if the unit is trimmed; the unit totalDuration.
